question: Should this broad stacked branch be the canonical publisher follow/feed implementation, or should it be split/restacked behind the narrower open follow graph, controls, and notification PRs?
rationale: The branch introduces durable schema/API/UI/product behavior and overlaps several open draft PRs, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent scope or merge order.

options.title: Restack and prove the full stack
options.body: Keep the broad branch as the candidate, resolve conflicts, reconcile sibling PRs, and require live browser/API plus Convex runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Split to feed routes only
options.body: Limit this PR to canonical feed URLs and profile links, leaving follow graph and notifications to narrower PRs.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Leave the draft parked until maintainers confirm the feed/follow product model and API contract.

recommendation.title: Restack and prove the full stack
recommendation.body: Keep the broad branch as the candidate, resolve conflicts, reconcile sibling PRs, and require live browser/API plus Convex runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has the strongest current-main route/schema baseline signal for the surfaces this PR extends.
